---
title: "Unlisted note"
description: "A child NOT draft, marked unlisted: true, of a section that is visible, used to check that the sidebar does not list it either in the nested recursion."
unlisted: true
---
A child `unlisted: true` (not draft) of a section that is visible by itself,
used to check that `visibleChildren()` also respects `unlisted()`, not only
`allowed()`.
